scope.notes: This is a full greenfield system across apps/web, apps/api, apps/infra, root Compose/runtime files, a PostgreSQL schema/migrations, integration adapters, operations guides, and bilingual documentation.

integration.notes: Coordinates OAuth and token validation/refresh, Twitch Helix rewards/redemptions/chat, EventSub WebSocket, local browser access, Compose, and filesystem-backed local secrets.

infrastructure.notes: Introduces a PostgreSQL service, Prisma schema and real migrations, Compose dependency/health ordering, durable local volumes, local bootstrap, Docker image, and operational scripts.

knowledge.notes: Requires verified current API/SDK behavior, financial recovery semantics across a remote API and local database, PostgreSQL transaction/partial-index behavior, local security, and strict JavaScript-only Prisma compatibility.

risk.notes: Incorrect outcomes can falsely claim a refund/consumption, lose a durable financial intent, disclose UID/secrets, or delete rewards whose pending redemptions Twitch would otherwise fulfill.

flags: Break work into independently testable stories
Do not progress to implementation before source research and spec critique are complete
